description: MainActivity.java: An Android Activity class that interacts with Google Play Services for Wear OS. It manages connections, sends/receives data and messages with wearable devices, handles camera interaction to take and send photos, and updates data items periodically.

classes.name: DataItemAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter to display Event objects in a list.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Simple class representing an event with title and text.

classes.name: StartWearableActivityTask
classes.description: AsyncTask to send start activity message to connected wearable nodes.

classes.name: DataItemGenerator
classes.description: Runnable class that periodically creates and sends a data item with a count.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, UI components, and GoogleApiClient connection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects the GoogleApiClient on activity start.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts the periodic data item generation.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops the periodic data item generation.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes listeners and disconnects the GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from camera activity, retrieves thumbnail bitmap.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback when GoogleApiClient connects; registers listeners.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Handles suspension of GoogleApiClient connectivity.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Handles failures to connect to GoogleApiClient, attempts resolution.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Handles incoming data events.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages from wearable.

methods.name: onCapabilityChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to capability API.

methods.name: setupViews
methods.description: Initializes UI elements and assigns callbacks.

methods.name: onTakePhotoClick
methods.description: Triggers camera intent for taking photo.

methods.name: onSendPhotoClick
methods.description: Sends captured photo as an asset to the wearable.

methods.name: onStartWearableActivityClick
methods.description: Starts a wearable activity remotely via message.

methods.name: sendStartActivityMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to start activity on the wearable.

methods.name: dispatchTakePictureIntent
methods.description: Starts camera intent to take photo.

methods.name: toAsset
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap image to an Asset for transfer.

methods.name: sendPhoto
methods.description: Puts photo asset into DataApi as a DataItem.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Retrieves connected wearable nodes.

methods.name: LOGD
methods.description: Helper function for debug logging.
